name: PdxBlockUi
description:
A loading overlay that wraps content and, while blocked, stops interaction with it and covers it
with a semi-transparent overlay and a spinner.

members.name: blocked
members.description: Whether the UI is blocked (shows overlay + spinner)

members.name: fullscreen
members.description: Cover the viewport, not the element, and make the rest of the document inert.

members.name: delay
members.description: Ms before the overlay is drawn. The input is blocked from the start either way.

members.name: minDuration
members.description: Ms the overlay stays drawn once it is, however soon the block ends.

events.name: pdx-block
events.description: The overlay is drawn: past its delay, the moment a person sees it.

events.name: pdx-unblock
events.description: The overlay is taken away and the input given back.

cssParts.name: overlay
cssParts.description: The overlay over the wrapped content.

cssParts.name: spinner
cssParts.description: The group in the overlay that holds the spinner and the message.

cssParts.name: message

cssStates.name: blocked
cssStates.description: The input is blocked: from the moment `blocked` turns on until the overlay is taken away.

cssStates.name: shown
cssStates.description: The overlay is drawn: past its `delay`, and for at least `min-duration`.
